mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_options WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY option_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_options ( product_id, option_key, option_sku, option_price, display_yn, sale_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{optionKey}, #{optionSku}, #{optionPrice}, #{displayYn}, #{saleStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_options SET product_id = #{productId}, option_key = #{optionKey}, option_sku = #{optionSku}, option_price = #{optionPrice}, display_yn = #{displayYn}, sale_status = #{saleStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE option_id = #{optionId}
